<vt...@blueyonder.co.uk> writes

>sorry for the misunderstanding, it was meant to say telephatic counter
>rather than TP. unfortuantly some of our newbies who use the NG
>through our machine don't quite know the shorts for everything.t here
>is no need to be quite so nasty towards them.

Pointing out that we don't understand what they mean isn't being nasty;
it's pointing out we don't know what they mean. It would also be useful
if they flagged themself up as someone else when posting via your
account, most likely.

It may be useful to tell them to use the long version of card names. In
general, it works best if you use the long version the first time you
type it, then go to abbreviations afterwards, *especially* when you
don't have the context of talking about a big bad Brujah deck so people
will probably be able to guess what you mean by IG.

Regarding the question:

Get them to read [1.6.3.5] of the Final Nights rulebook:

5. Reaction cards: A ready untapped minion can play a reaction card in
response to an action taken by another Methuselah's minion...
